`./setup.sh` on Linux and macOS and `./setup.ps1` on Windows run the install stepper in `tools/setup`. Both wrappers pass their arguments through unchanged. The usage text below is the one the stepper prints.

## Usage

```
themerchantengine setup

Usage: node tools/setup/dist/index.js [options]

Options:
  --profile <engine|storefront|both|local>  What this box runs. Asked when omitted.
  --local                                   Shorthand for --profile local.
  --answers <file.json>                     Non-interactive run from an answers document.
  --dry-run                                 Print every file and command; write and run nothing.
  --state <file>                            Resumable state file (default .setup-state.json).
  --root <dir>                              Repository root (default: the current directory).
  --reset                                   Ignore the state file and start over.
  --help                                    This text.
  --version                                 The engine version.
```

## Flags

- `--profile <engine|storefront|both|local>`: What this box runs. Asked when omitted.
- `--local`: Shorthand for --profile local.
- `--answers <file.json>`: Non-interactive run from an answers document.
- `--dry-run`: Print every file and command; write and run nothing.
- `--state <file>`: Resumable state file (default .setup-state.json).
- `--root <dir>`: Repository root (default: the current directory).
- `--reset`: Ignore the state file and start over.
- `--help`: This text.
- `--version`: The engine version.

## Profiles

- `engine`
- `storefront`
- `both`
- `local`

The resumable state file defaults to `.setup-state.json` in the repository root and never holds a secret.

## The answers file

A JSON document for `--answers <file.json>`. Every field, with `required` meaning the schema refuses the file without it:

- `profile` (`"engine"`, `"storefront"`, `"both"`, `"local"`, optional).
- `identity` (object, optional).
  - `identity.storeName` (object, optional).
  - `identity.brandName` (string, optional).
  - `identity.description` (object, optional).
  - `identity.legalName` (object, optional).
  - `identity.contactEmail` (string, optional).
  - `identity.contactPhone` (string, optional).
  - `identity.street` (object, optional).
  - `identity.locality` (string, optional).
  - `identity.region` (string, optional).
  - `identity.postalCode` (string or null, optional).
  - `identity.country` (string, optional).
  - `identity.areaServed` (array of string, optional).
  - `identity.businessType` (`"OnlineStore"`, `"LocalBusiness"`, `"Hybrid"`, optional).
- `domains` (object, optional).
  - `domains.storefront` (string, optional).
  - `domains.admin` (string, optional).
  - `domains.api` (string, optional).
  - `domains.certbotEmail` (string, optional).
- `brand` (object, optional).
  - `brand.primary` (string, pattern `^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$`, optional).
  - `brand.secondary` (string, pattern `^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$` or `""` or null, optional).
  - `brand.accent` (string, pattern `^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$` or `""` or null, optional).
  - `brand.fontKit` (`"latin-rounded"`, `"arabic-latin"`, optional).
  - `brand.logoPath` (string, optional).
- `localization` (object, optional).
  - `localization.supportedLocales` (array of `"fr"`, `"en"`, `"ar"`, optional).
  - `localization.defaultLocale` (`"fr"`, `"en"`, `"ar"`, optional).
  - `localization.rtlLocales` (array of `"fr"`, `"en"`, `"ar"`, optional).
  - `localization.timezone` (string, optional).
- `money` (object, optional).
  - `money.currencyCode` (string, optional).
  - `money.symbol` (string, optional).
  - `money.symbolPosition` (`"before"`, `"after"`, optional).
  - `money.decimalSeparator` (string, optional).
  - `money.thousandsSeparator` (string, optional).
  - `money.displayPrecision` (integer, min 0, max 3, optional).
  - `money.taxDisplay` (`"HT"`, `"TTC"`, `"none"`, optional).
  - `money.vatRate` (number, min 0, max 1, optional).
  - `money.vatPercent` (number, min 0, max 100, optional).
  - `money.shippingFlatRate` (number, min 0, optional).
- `storage` (object, optional).
  - `storage.driver` (`"s3"`, `"local"`, optional).
  - `storage.endpoint` (string, optional).
  - `storage.region` (string, optional).
  - `storage.bucket` (string, optional).
  - `storage.publicUrl` (string, optional).
  - `storage.accessKey` (string, optional).
  - `storage.secretKey` (string, optional).
- `mail` (object, optional).
  - `mail.transport` (`"resend"`, `"console"`, optional).
  - `mail.apiKey` (string, optional).
  - `mail.webhookSecret` (string, optional).
  - `mail.fromEmail` (string, optional).
  - `mail.fromName` (string, optional).
  - `mail.replyTo` (string, optional).
  - `mail.contactFormRecipient` (string, optional).
  - `mail.devRedirectTo` (string, optional).
  - `mail.testRecipient` (string, optional).
- `turnstile` (object, optional).
  - `turnstile.enabled` (boolean, optional).
  - `turnstile.siteKey` (string, optional).
  - `turnstile.secretKey` (string, optional).
- `seo` (object, optional).
  - `seo.indexNowKey` (`""` or string, pattern `^[a-f0-9]{8,128}$`, optional).
  - `seo.bingApiKey` (string, optional).
  - `seo.gscServiceAccountFile` (string, optional).
  - `seo.gscSiteUrl` (string, optional).
- `payments` (object, optional).
  - `payments.cod` (boolean, optional).
  - `payments.stripe` (boolean, optional).
  - `payments.stripeApiKey` (string, optional).
  - `payments.stripeWebhookSecret` (string, optional).
  - `payments.manual` (boolean, optional).
- `owner` (object, optional).
  - `owner.email` (string, optional).
  - `owner.firstName` (string, optional).
  - `owner.lastName` (string, optional).
  - `owner.password` (string, optional).
- `demoCatalogue` (boolean, optional).
- `engine` (object, optional).
  - `engine.revalidateSecret` (string, optional).
  - `engine.apiUrl` (string, optional).
